author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕೆಲಸಗಳ ಯೋಜಿಸಿರೆ ಸಂಕಲ್ಪ ಸಿದ್ಧಿಪುದು
ಹಲವರಿಗೆ ಕೆಲಕೆಲಸ ಆಪ್ಯಾಯಮಾನ
ತಲಸ್ಪರ್ಶಿ ಜ್ಞಾನಿಯನನುಸರಿಸಿ ಯೋಜಿಸಿರೆ
ಗೆಲುವುಂಟು ಕೆಲಸದಲಿ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you plan your work, the resolve is fulfilled;
to many people, some kinds of work are a delight;
if you plan by following a thoroughly learned person,
there is victory in the work, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Good planning makes intentions come true. Learn from people with deep knowledge, plan accordingly, and the work succeeds.
